title: Vaseegara
desc: Bhupathi's father sends him to live under the guidance of his best friend, Viswanath, and find a job. He gets close to the family and falls in love with Viswanath's daughter, who is already engaged.

title: Mariyaan
desc: Mariyaan Joseph, a fisherman, is forced to take up employment in Sudan after his girlfriend faces financial issues. However, he finds himself in danger after crossing paths with some extremists.

title: Iraivi
desc: Three friends who are struggling financially put their partners in trouble.

title: 49-O
desc: When the farmers of a village are tricked into selling their lands to a local politician, a man sympathetic to the plight of farmers decides to get them their properties back.

title: Thavamai Thavamirunthu
desc: Saradha and Muthaiah, a village-based couple, face financial difficulties while raising their two sons, Ramanathan and Ramalingam. Problems escalate when Ramalingam gets his girlfriend pregnant.
